name: if the world ended with you.
source:
[i]if one day, the world crumbled around you, what would you do?[/i]

two highschool classmates try to survive the apocalypse.

[From [url=https://egakujamu.itch.io/if-the-world-ended-with-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]倘若某一天，你周遭的世界轰然崩塌，你会怎么做？[/i]

两名高中同班同学努力在末日浩劫中求生的故事。

[摘自[url=https://egakujamu.itch.io/if-the-world-ended-with-you]itch.io[/url]]
